functions.justification: Returns only whether the current admin is explicitly allowlisted while the server setting is enabled; it exposes no KYC rows or metadata.

must_pass: cross-gender rows only for enabled super-admin
every exceptional cross-gender read is audited
only an authorized dossier yields object metadata
controllers cannot obtain a KYC access verdict
admin without gender receives adminSansGenre when exception is inactive
enabled super-admin receives exceptionSuperAdmin for cross-gender access
missing or deleted dossier returns only profilNonAutorise
verdict returns no document metadata, object key, or signed URL
verdict itself writes no audit row; opening remains audited by the existing RPC
